intent: Implement GPS panel and trace controls for field measurement
evidence: GpsTraceControls.tsx provides UI for starting, pausing, and finishing GPS traces, with live stats for distance and area.

intent: Develop georeferencing and Kalman filter for coordinate transformation
evidence: geo-transform.ts contains solveAffine algorithms and updateKalman for smoothing GPS noise and mapping to plan XY.

intent: Handle geolocation permissions and accuracy monitoring
evidence: geolocation.ts shim handles high-accuracy mode and permissions across native/web; GpsTraceControls displays accuracy alerts.
GpsCalibration.tsx manages the workflow of benchmarking physical site locations against PDF plan coordinates.

intent: Optimize mobile UI for field usage
evidence: Index.tsx includes a mobile-specific layout with MobileTabBar, MobilePayItems, and MobileAnnotationSheet for touch-first operation.

intent: Integrate camera capture with GPS metadata capability
evidence: camera.ts provides native/web capture; ProjectControls.tsx handles photo uploads with hooks for AI tagging and geolocation association.
gaps: Explicit GPS metadata embedding in photo blobs before upload is not fully visible in the current capture shim.
